verses.ala-asikhu-lana-ya-ikhwata-d-dini-c1-v1: ʾalā ʾaṣīkhū lanā yā ʾikhwata d-dīni ʾafidkumu ḥikamā mithla r-rayāḥīni
verses.ala-asikhu-lana-ya-ikhwata-d-dini-c1-v2: waman yakun ghayru ʾahli sh-shiykhi laqqanahu fadhū ntisābi ʿani t-tijjāni mamnūni
verses.ala-asikhu-lana-ya-ikhwata-d-dini-c1-v3: ʾin qulta dhāka lahu lil-jamʿi qultu naʿam lakinnamā sharṭunā ʾifrādu talqīni
verses.ala-asikhu-lana-ya-ikhwata-d-dini-c1-v4: liʾanna dhā l-wirda bil-ʾifrādi jāʾa lanā ʿan quṭbinā ʿan rasūli khayri maʾamūni
verses.ala-asikhu-lana-ya-ikhwata-d-dini-c1-v5: qad qāla lish-shaykhi fātruk mā ʾakhadhta bihi hādī l-bariyyati sulṭānu s-salaṭīni
verses.ala-asikhu-lana-ya-ikhwata-d-dini-c1-v6: mā lam yanal ʾaṣlunā fī l-ʾamri laysa lanā fī naylihi ṭamaʿu lā tarḍa bid-dūni
verses.ala-asikhu-lana-ya-ikhwata-d-dini-c1-v7: mā kāna man kāna bit-taḥqīqi ṣāḥibuhu sharqā wagharbā ʾakhā jamʿi ʾilā l-ḥīni
verses.ala-asikhu-lana-ya-ikhwata-d-dini-c1-v8: wafīhimu ṣāḥi man fīhim mina l-ʾudabā wal-ʾawliyāʾi lidhī l-ʾinṣāfi wad-dīni
verses.ala-asikhu-lana-ya-ikhwata-d-dini-c1-v9: wal-ʾajnabiyyū ʾidhā mā kāna khālafahum fala yaḍurru bilā shakki watamyīni
verses.ala-asikhu-lana-ya-ikhwata-d-dini-c1-v10: wamayyizū jamaʿa r-raḥmanu shamlakumu lā talbisū n-nāsa ʾin jāʾū litabyīni
verses.ala-asikhu-lana-ya-ikhwata-d-dini-c1-v11: fadhū t-tabarruki fī t-tawsīʿi ʾinna lahu fiʿla lladhī shāʾa min jamʿi watabyīni
verses.ala-asikhu-lana-ya-ikhwata-d-dini-c1-v12: halāku man tarakū lā shakka ʾin dakhalū bil-iltizāmi faʾawfū jiddu taʿyīni
verses.ala-asikhu-lana-ya-ikhwata-d-dini-c1-v13: yā man yulaqqinu marʾā ghayra multazimi ʾiyyāka ʾiyyāka ʾighwāʾa sh-shayāṭīni
verses.ala-asikhu-lana-ya-ikhwata-d-dini-c1-v14: qālū l-mulaqqinu ʾatwā min mulaqqanihi ʾin kāna muqtaṣirā fī waqti taʾadhīni
verses.ala-asikhu-lana-ya-ikhwata-d-dini-c1-v15: famā murādiyā ʾinkāru l-mashāyikhi min qalbī walā qālabī mithla l-majānīni
verses.ala-asikhu-lana-ya-ikhwata-d-dini-c1-v17: ʾinnā ʾaqūlu bilā ʾinkāri fayḍihimi lā ʿiṭra baʿda ʿarūsi mithla tāni
verses.ala-asikhu-lana-ya-ikhwata-d-dini-c1-v18: wash-shaykhu qaṣṣara mā yanhā liṣāḥibihi bidhāka ʾanṣafa fī manʿi watashyīni
verses.ala-asikhu-lana-ya-ikhwata-d-dini-c1-v19: ʾini ddaʿaytum bikashfi qad ʾajāza lanā mā sh-shaykhu māniʿuhu fallāhi yahdīnī
verses.ala-asikhu-lana-ya-ikhwata-d-dini-c1-v20: wakam khayāli khabālu ʿinda man ʿarafū wabāṭini bāṭilu yawma l-mawāzīni
verses.ala-asikhu-lana-ya-ikhwata-d-dini-c1-v21: yā rabbi ṣalli ʿalā l-mukhtāri sayyidinā wal-ʾāli waṣ-ṣaḥbi fī kulli l-ʾaḥāyīni
verses.ala-asikhu-lana-ya-ikhwata-d-dini-c1-v16: ʾin kāna zaynu murīdi fī attitāʿi murā di fāʿlamū ʾannanā fī dhalika l-bīni
